reason: Run against 4.1.7 and 5.0.5 with 4 workers in forks/threads/vmThreads, VITEST_POOL_ID was already 1..N on 4.1.7 and only VITEST_WORKER_ID (an unbounded per-worker counter, used only for uniqueness) and the new-in-5.0 diagnostic workerId moved to 1-based, so no plausible app or test-setup code (per-worker DB names, ports, array indexes from the pool id) behaves differently.
Only affects how many browser instances/pages browser mode opens, which needs a real browser and a browser provider the template can't install.
Only changes vi.mock automocking inside browser mode, which needs a real browser and a browser provider the template can't install.
The browser.isolate option only matters when browser mode runs, which needs a real browser and a browser provider the template can't install.

Only toThrow('') changed; tried framing tests that assert an error is thrown or not, but plausible test code passes a message substring, a RegExp or nothing, and asserting an empty error message with toThrow('') isn't something application tests do.
browser.api only configures browser mode's server, which needs a real browser and a browser provider the template can't install to exercise.

The @vitest/runner and @vitest/ws-client deprecation is announced only in the migration guide: the packages carry no npm deprecation, no @deprecated tag and no runtime warning (and the template doesn't install them).
toHaveTextContent changed only as a browser-mode expect.element matcher, which needs a real browser and a browser provider the template can't install.
